title: Sub-Exponential Refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis via Homological Certificate Topologies on Conflict-Clause Poset Lattices (Lean 4 Formalization, Interactive Poset Visualizer, and Cryptographic Proof Certificates)
description: Curated Zenodo publication package containing: (1) the complete IEEEtran LaTeX manuscript and compiled PDF ('Sub-Exponential Refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis via Homological Certificate Topologies on Conflict-Clause Poset Lattices') with all restored sections (Equation 1 sub-exponential bound, Section VII Architectural Alignment with @BenFrohman repositories NS_Millennium_Proof and FSymHD via Monad Reduction, State Injection, and Presburger Arithmetic omega, Section VIII Multi-Kernel Gauntlet list nanoda, lean4lean, con-leche, con-ron under lake check --paranoid, and IEEEtran bibliography); (2) high-resolution poset Hasse diagrams (lattice_visualization_1.jpg and lattice_visualization_2.jpg) and the interactive 27-clause/54-edge HTML5 visualizer (conflict_clause_lattice.html) with a zero-sorry Lean 4 Step-Counting Monad; (3) the standalone Lean 4 package ConflictClauseLattice (56 verified theorems, 0 sorry, 0 non-standard axioms); and (4) Ed25519-signed Titan-Audit and SealGuard SHA-256 Merkle provenance certificates.
